liveOps.note: the longest a scheduled live event may run, in minutes (7 days); a row longer than this is refused at load

zone1Hop.note: how long an abandoned sign-in's Zone 1 hop mark stays valid, in ms (10 minutes), so it cannot send a much later arena sign-in to Zone 1

tradeLock.note: seconds a freshly looted, minted or bought piece waits before it can be offered (72 hours)

tradeCooldownStep.note: after its 1st change of hands the new owner waits 7 days
after its 2nd change of hands: 14 days
after its 3rd change of hands: 30 days; every later trade uses the last step
